integrity: An analytical proof is supplied and a standard-library numerical checker is supplementary only. Historical priority beyond inspected sources is not independently guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer oversampling and a single erased Cauchy atom only. No uniqueness of transition in pole depth, no uniform simultaneous redundancy limit. General rank-one lemma and unperturbed frame bounds are prior background. Independent verification remains unperformed.
title: A spectral-edge transition under single-atom erasure of Cauchy Gabor frames
